name: SDLPoP
description: SDLPoP is an open-source port of Prince of Persia built from a disassembly of the original DOS version. Written by David Nagy (NagyD), it runs on modern systems with SDL2 and adds replays, mod support, gamepad control and optional bug fixes. The original game was created by Jordan Mechner for the Apple II in 1989.
curiosities: Jordan Mechner made the prince's lifelike animation by rotoscoping video of his younger brother running and jumping.
The game gives you 60 minutes of in-game time to rescue the princess.
Mechner's original Apple II source code was recovered from old floppy disks in 2012.
SDLPoP's fixes for original bugs can be switched off to play exactly like the DOS version.
story: Jordan Mechner created Prince of Persia in 1989, animated by filming his brother running and jumping.
SDLPoP is a port of the original DOS version made from its disassembled code.
It lets the classic run on modern systems as it did in 1990.
